title: デビュー戦の後に・幕開け、ここから

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: (The moment I rounded the fourth corner and came in front of the stands, I honestly thought my legs were going to give out.)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: (The crowd was roaring, their eyes all on me. I could feel the voices—so many voices—closing in…)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: (I thought that maybe I hadn't made any progress at all, but then…)
choice_data_list: Dober! Stay strong! Show 'em what you've got!
Dober! Stay strong! Show 'em what you've got!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I… can do this! Hryahhh!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I will! Watch me! Hryahhh!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Huff… huff… huff…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: (My vision is blurry, my legs won't stop shaking, and my heart feels like it's about to explode!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: But that just proves… how hard I ran!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I ran with all my strength! In an actual race!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Oh… Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I-it's not that big a deal… This is just the first step, nothing to get that excited over.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Th-this is just my debut! It's embarrassing to see you get so excited over me…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Still, um…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: No, I'm sorry. I don't mean that. I'm… actually really happy too.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I was able to finish that race without any regrets because of you, so… thanks.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I heard you cheering for me… Thank you, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Afterward, while packing up our things…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Hello, Dober!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Congratulations on your debut!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Bright… Thank you. I couldn't have done it without you.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: You were so cool out there, Dober! We could feel your muscles pulsing from the stands!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Y-you don't mean literally, right?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: …Thank you, though. I appreciate you saying that.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: That was a fine run, Dober. I hope you'll continue to do your best in the races ahead.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I will! Thank you so much.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Teehee. I hope you'll come cheer me on when it's my turn to debut, Dober.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: I'll be sure to show you a breathtaking race myself.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Of course, I'll be there. Train hard, okay?

text_block_list.name: TV
text_block_list.text: Next up, we're spotlighting a rookie you should keep an eye out for in the Twinkle Series!

text_block_list.name: TV
text_block_list.text: Mejiro Dober debuted just the other day, and as an up-and-comer of the Mejiro family, it's no surprise she's already gaining attention…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's not long before the world pins Dober as the Mejiro family's new hope. We'll have to work even harder to meet their expectations!
